name: Scapular Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder-width using an overhand grip with completely straight arms and relaxed shoulders.
Brace your core tightly so your body stays steady without swinging.
Keeping your elbows completely straight, pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together to lift your body a few inches upward.
Pause briefly at the top of the scapular depression, then lower smoothly back into the relaxed dead hang.
tips: Do not bend your elbows at all; the small rise comes strictly from depressing and retracting your shoulder blades.
Avoid arching your lower back excessively as you engage your lats and lower traps.
